[h1] Design Director
[h2] A Job Where Control Issues Are Considered a Skill
[p] Full Time
[p] Remote
[p] Since 2015, we’ve partnered with everyone from global giants to startups with big-character energy. Crafting identities, design, digital experiences, and content for brands we believe in.
[h4] The Role
[p] We’re looking for a Design Director who lives at the crossroads of strategy + craft + act-fast innovation. This person will steer our creative ship, mentor the crew, and push our studio and clients to do incredible work.
[p] You’ll lead design vision across brand, digital, motion, and product, working directly with leadership, creative teams, and clients. You’ll set the bar high, question the status quo, and make great design feel inevitable.
[h4] What You'll Do
[li] Define and evolve our creative vision, ensuring it’s bold, original and aligned to ToyFight’s values.
[li] Lead, mentor, and nurture our team of designers.
[li] Oversee multi-disciplinary design projects end-to-end.
[li] Ensure design work is not only beautiful but functional, on-brand, on-brief and on-time.
[li] Stay ahead of trends, you’ll bring fresh thinking and ambition to the mix.
[li] Maintain and develop the studio’s design standards.
[h4] What You’ll Bring
[li] We'd prefer around 5+ years of design experience in an agency.
[li] Demonstrable excellence in design (and a portfolio to prove it).
[li] A strategic mindset.
[li] Great taste and appreciation for design.
[li] Fluent with design tools & processes.
[li] Great communicator, you can speak design to designers, and with confidence and verve to clients.
[li] A playful irreverence. (Yes. You’ll still be serious about design. But we appreciate a bit of playfulness now and then)
[h4] Why Join Us
[li] You’ll lead a bright, agile studio doing meaningful work, not endless cookie-cutter campaigns.
[li] We invest in your training, conferences, and gear you need to make the good stuff.
[li] A culture of candour, curiosity and boldness.
[li] Competitive salary + benefits (we’ll talk specifics later).
[h4] Location
[p] Wherever you want.
[h4] Salary
[p] £DOE
[p] 4 Day Working Week
[p] The four-day week at ToyFight is our way of handing back a fifth of your life without taking a thing off the table. It runs on a simple ethos, all of your pay, four days of your time, none of the quality lost. The extra day is yours. Sleep in, see people, go and be a person. We didn't do it to seem generous, we did it because rested people make original work, and tired people make ordinary work. Ordinary is the enemy.
[p] Flexible Hours
[p] Enjoy the ability to adjust your work hours, offering you control over your schedule and working the way you want. Helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
[p] Remote Working
[p] We champion the art of remote working. Revel in the tranquility of your personal sanctuary, slippers and all.
[p] Vacation
[p] With a generous offering of 28 vacation days, we don't just urge you to take a break; we celebrate your adventures. This is your time to rest, to live and find time for yourself, family and friends.
[p] Annual Bonuses
[p] Our annual bonuses are not mere transactions (or bottles of booze); they are our way of saying thank you, a tangible testament to the value and impact of your work.
[p] Personal Days
[p] In addition to our generous standard leave you can enjoy additional personal days for those times when life requires your attention outside of work.
[p] Choice of Subs
[p] Select from a range of subscriptions as part of your employment package. These subs cover a wide range of interests from film, music, learning and much more tailored to your personal or professional interests.

[h1] Motion Designer
[h2] Keyframe Kings and Queens
[p] Full Time
[p] Remote
[p] Come join the team at ToyFight. We're a team of strategists, designers, developers and technologists with a passion for creating digital experiences for consumers and brands.
[h4] The Role
[p] You are a passionate motion designer who thrives on creating dynamic, engaging experiences across digital platforms.
[p] With your creative flair, you’ll collaborate on a variety of projects and briefs alongside the design and development teams, focusing on 2D interface, digital product prototypes, proof of concepts and brand motion design—plus, any skills in 3D animation and motion are a welcomed bonus.
[p] You will have a strong creative point of view but know how to collaborate, take feedback constructively, and discern when to push back and when to listen.
[p] You excel in team environments and can manage your own workload effectively to meet deadlines while delivering work that exceeds expectations.
[h4] What You'll Do
[li] Create motion designs that elevate interfaces, brands, and digital experiences.
[li] Collaborate with teams to bring ideas to life through motion and prototyping.
[li] Apply attention to detail and care for design to make a meaningful impact.
[li] Work with diverse clients—from startups to global brands—on a wide variety of projects.
[li] Bring concepts to life, clearly articulating your vision through strategic thinking, motion, and visual storytelling.
[h4] What You’ll Bring
[li] 3+ years of motion design experience.
[li] Ability to understand briefs, strategy and offer effective solutions to complex problems.
[li] A love for all aspects of design and animation, including conceptual thinking.
[li] Strong understanding of motion tools such as, After Effects, Jitter and other editors.
[li] Able to present work through excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
[li] Ability to create storyboards.
[li] Bonus points for skills in illustration, and 3D.
[p] Use the 'Apply Now' button, or email careers@toyfight.co with the subject 'Motion Designer Role'.
[h4] Location
[p] Wherever you want.
[h4] Salary
[p] £DOE
[p] 4 Day Working Week
[p] The four-day week at ToyFight is our way of handing back a fifth of your life without taking a thing off the table. It runs on a simple ethos, all of your pay, four days of your time, none of the quality lost. The extra day is yours. Sleep in, see people, go and be a person. We didn't do it to seem generous, we did it because rested people make original work, and tired people make ordinary work. Ordinary is the enemy.
[p] Flexible Hours
[p] Enjoy the ability to adjust your work hours, offering you control over your schedule and working the way you want. Helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
[p] Remote Working
[p] We champion the art of remote working. Revel in the tranquility of your personal sanctuary, slippers and all.
[p] Vacation
[p] With a generous offering of 28 vacation days, we don't just urge you to take a break; we celebrate your adventures. This is your time to rest, to live and find time for yourself, family and friends.
[p] Annual Bonuses
[p] Our annual bonuses are not mere transactions (or bottles of booze); they are our way of saying thank you, a tangible testament to the value and impact of your work.

[p] In addition to our generous standard leave you can enjoy additional personal days for those times when life requires your attention outside of work.

[h1] Senior Digital Designer
[h2] King of the Rectangles
[p] Full Time
[p] Remote
[p] Come join the team at ToyFight. We're a team of strategists, designers, developers and technologists with a passion for creating digital experiences for consumers and brands.
[h4] The Role
[p] We’re looking for a talented Senior Digital Designer to join our team.
[p] You’ll work across a broad range of projects, from websites and interactive experiences to digital products and campaigns. Working closely with our Creative Directors, developers and wider creative team, you’ll help shape ideas and turn them into considered, beautifully crafted digital experiences.
[p] You’ll be comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial concepts and exploration through to detailed design and final delivery.
[h4] What You'll Do
[li] Create thoughtful, original and beautifully crafted digital experiences.
[li] Take ownership of design across projects, from initial concepts through to final delivery.
[li] Work closely with our team to develop and refine creative ideas.
[li] Collaborate with developers throughout the design and build process.
[li] Present work clearly and confidently to both the team and clients.
[li] Consider interaction, motion and behaviour as an integral part of the design process.
[li] Contribute to maintaining and developing the studio’s design standards.
[li] Stay informed about new tools, technologies and developments within digital design.
[li] The confidence to take ownership of your work while being open to collaboration, feedback and direction.
[li] Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate the thinking behind your work.
[li] An enthusiasm for digital design and a genuine interest in continuing to develop your craft.
[h4] What You’ll Bring
[li] Around 4+ years of digital design experience, ideally within an agency or studio environment.
[li] A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent digital design, ideas and craft.
[li] Excellent visual design, typography and layout skills.
[li] A strong understanding of UX, interaction and responsive design.
[li] A high level of attention to detail and a strong eye for what makes great design.
[li] Excellent knowledge of Figma and contemporary digital design processes.
[li] An understanding of motion, 3D, WebGL or creative development would be a plus. You don’t need to build these experiences yourself, but an understanding of their possibilities is important.
[h4] Why Join Us
[li] Work on ambitious digital projects for a broad range of interesting brands.
[li] The opportunity to experiment with new technologies, tools and approaches.
[li] Work alongside an experienced team with a strong focus on ideas and craft.
[li] Opportunities for training, conferences and continued professional development.
[li] The tools and equipment you need to do your best work.
[li] A culture built around collaboration, curiosity and high standards.
[li] Competitive salary and benefits.
[li] 4 Day Week 100:80:100
[h4] Location
[p] Wherever you want.
[h4] Salary
[p] £DOE
[p] 4 Day Working Week
[p] The four-day week at ToyFight is our way of handing back a fifth of your life without taking a thing off the table. It runs on a simple ethos, all of your pay, four days of your time, none of the quality lost. The extra day is yours. Sleep in, see people, go and be a person. We didn't do it to seem generous, we did it because rested people make original work, and tired people make ordinary work. Ordinary is the enemy.
[p] Flexible Hours
[p] Enjoy the ability to adjust your work hours, offering you control over your schedule and working the way you want. Helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance.
[p] Remote Working
[p] We champion the art of remote working. Revel in the tranquility of your personal sanctuary, slippers and all.
[p] Vacation
[p] With a generous offering of 28 vacation days, we don't just urge you to take a break; we celebrate your adventures. This is your time to rest, to live and find time for yourself, family and friends.
[p] Annual Bonuses
[p] Our annual bonuses are not mere transactions (or bottles of booze); they are our way of saying thank you, a tangible testament to the value and impact of your work.
[p] Personal Days
[p] In addition to our generous standard leave you can enjoy additional personal days for those times when life requires your attention outside of work.

[p] Select from a range of subscriptions as part of your employment package. These subs cover a wide range of interests from film, music, learning and much more tailored to your personal or professional interests.

[h1] Building GSAP ≈ ASAP
[p] Article March 2024
[p] Article
[h2] Building GSAP ≈ ASAP
[p] Article March 2024
[p] It goes without saying, but well, maybe it doesn’t get said enough. Still, for us one of the fundamental aspects of the success of this project was working with amazing and talented clients like Cassie and Jack and of course, the extended GSAP crew and community. Throughout the project they were phenomenal and always encouraged us to explore more and see where we could take it.
[p] This wasn’t just another flashy site, this site had to perform too, for users new and old, and help drive business growth.
[h4] The Ask
[p] We were asked to conceive and develop a website experience that embodies and amplifies the newly created brand identity for GreenSock. The primary goal of this initiative was to demonstrate why GSAP (Formely GreenSock) is the go-to tool for animation.
[p] GSAP's widespread use was evident, already powering over 11 million websites, many of which were award-winning.
[h4] Our Goals
[p] In undertaking this project, we first aimed to lay the foundations for the brand, creating a robust platform for future development and innovation. Secondly, a key goal was to drive awareness of becoming a club GSAP member. Thirdly, we sought to position the new brand as an exciting and progressive force in the industry. And finally, we aimed to showcase the sheer creativity and versatility of the GSAP tools and its users.
[h4] Giving It Some Flair
[p] A pivotal element of our execution was the development and introduction of a central protagonist in the brands' visual language, which we called 'Flair.' Flair is an embodiment of the spirit and capabilities of GSAP. Serving as the cornerstone of product stories and demonstrations, Flair visually showcases the versatility and dynamism of GSAP's animation platform in the best possible way.
[p] In the development of our brand experience, a guiding principle was to remain authentic and true to the capabilities of GSAP. This commitment meant that every animation technique we employed was a showcase of creativity and a testament to what can be practically achieved using GSAP's animation tools.
[a] / Read Next ToyFight x GSAP = 2 Webby Awards!
[p] The A An All A An The Unmistakably Creative Innovative Interesting Inclusive Talented Opinionated Ultimate Original Unmistakably Original® Creative Bar Collection Group Bunch Exciting Original® Design Development And Of Design Studio Agency Team Restaurant Creatives Artists Bastards Studio

[h1] Fresh Faces Join ToyFight
[p] Article November 2024
[p] Article
[h2] Fresh Faces Join ToyFight
[p] Article November 2024
[p] We’re levelling up! ToyFight is delighted to welcome three stellar new hires to our design team as Interactive Designers. With fresh talent from leading agencies and a passion for creating unforgettable digital experiences, James, Pavle, and Boris are here to help us take on 2025 with bold ideas and boundless creativity.
[p] As we gear up for another year of bold, innovative work, we’re confident that this talented trio will play a key role in helping us continue to push boundaries and create standout digital experiences. Watch this space—we can’t wait to share what’s next.
[p] James Hartwell joins us from the Bureau for Visual Affairs, where he honed his craft designing for screen and brand. With a sharp eye for detail and a knack for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences, James is set to add a new layer of creative flair to the ToyFight team.
[p] Pavle Jonic comes to us from Holographik, bringing with him a wealth of experience in crafting interactive designs that captivate and inspire. Boris Spasojevic, also joining us from Holographik, rounds out our trio of new hires. With a deep passion for pushing the boundaries of digital design, Boris thrives on delivering work that’s as visually stunning as it is user-friendly.
[p] Since joining, James, Pavle, and Boris have hit the ground running, contributing to projects for some of our incredible clients, including PayPal, Meta, RICOH, and Royal Caribbean Cruises. Their skills have already brought fresh depth and quality to the studio’s creative output, and we’re excited to see how they’ll continue to elevate our work.

[h1] We're on a winning run
[p] Article November, 2025
[p] Article
[h2] We're on a winning run
[p] Article November, 2025
[h4] Awards, Mentions & Momentum
[p] It’s been a great few weeks back at ToyFight. With back-to-back launches, glowing feedback, and a few shiny things on the digital mantelpiece, we’re feeling the flow and having a fun ride.
[h4] Awwwards Wins Galore
[p] We were delighted to discover that three of our recent projects INK Games INK Games , Pantheon Media Group Pantheon Media Group , and Metropolis Metropolis have picked up Awwwards SOTD for their design, UX, innovation, and overall experience. Big shout to our friends at Datum Datum also, whose AI-driven CRE platform received an Honourable Mention. Smart tech, sharp design, and only just getting started.
[p] Pantheon was also featured in an article on Awwwards Awwwards , where we deep-dived into the build, the motion principles, and the madness that made it happen.
[h4] GSAP Showcase & Site of the Month
[p] To add more joy, Pantheon was also selected as a GSAP Featured Showcase GSAP Featured Showcase and awarded GSAP Site of the Month — a massive honour from the motion masters themselves.
[h4] What This Means
[p] This isn’t just about awards (though we’re not complaining). It’s about doing consistently great work with great people. Collaborating closely. Sweating the details. And staying brave enough to do things differently.
[p] As ever we’re grateful to all our clients, and the folks who seem to like us, and if the last few months are anything to go by, this run’s nowhere near over.
[p] Stay tuned to what’s next.

[h1] GSAP Wins Gold Lovie + People's Choice Award
[p] Article November 2024
[p] Article
[h2] GSAP Wins Gold Lovie + People's Choice Award
[p] Article November 2024
[p] We’re thrilled to announce that GSAP has added two more shiny accolades to its growing trophy shelf—a Gold Lovie Award and a People’s Choice Lovie Award in the Websites & Mobile Sites category! These wins are a testament to the bold innovation, creativity, and technical brilliance that GSAP represents, and we couldn’t be more chuffed to have worked with them on such an iconic project.
[p] To stand out among such fierce competition is no small feat, and earning both a jury-selected Gold and the coveted People’s Choice speaks volumes about the impact of GSAP’s digital presence.
[p] The Lovie Awards, Europe’s most prestigious celebration of internet excellence, received over 1,500 submissions from more than 30 countries this year, spotlighting the very best digital work across websites, apps, social content, and beyond.
[p] This latest win adds to an already dazzling list of awards for GSAP, including 2 Webby Awards, multiple Awwwards, and CSS Design Awards, all culminating in driving greater downloads, revenue, and recognition within the design and development community. Our collaboration with GSAP helped redefine their public-facing identity, turning them into an undeniable force within the digital landscape and even paving the way for their acquisition by Webflow earlier this year.
[p] We’re incredibly proud of what this partnership has achieved, and it’s heartening to see the hard work of both our teams recognised on such an esteemed stage.

[h1] ToyFight x GSAP = 2 Webby Awards!
[p] Article April 2024
[p] Article
[h2] ToyFight x GSAP = 2 Webby Awards!
[p] Article April 2024
[p] The new GSAP website has been named the winner in both the "Web Services & Applications" and "Best Use of Animation or Motion Graphics" categories at the 2024 Webbys!
[p] GSAP had already swept up an Awwwards Site of the Day and been nominated for Site of the Month, with one of our highest ever "Dev Scores" (8.49), so we had high hopes when we saw the Webby nominations.
[p] That said, the "Web Services & Applications" category was particularly competitive, with the site facing up against big hitters like Google, Spotify and GIPHY.
[p] Nevertheless, GSAP was named the winner of both categories, joining Apple, Rihanna, and Former President Barack Obama on the list of 2024 Webby winners, and we couldn't be prouder!
[p] We look forward to Barack (first name terms) giving us a shout out on his blog.

[h1] ToyFight Joins SoDA. Presumably on Purpose.
[p] Article November, 2025
[p] Article
[h2] ToyFight Joins SoDA. Presumably on Purpose.
[p] Article November, 2025
[h4] Whoop. We’re officially in.
[p] ToyFight has joined SoDA SoDA (the Society of Digital Agencies) and we couldn’t be happier to be rubbing shoulders with some of the best brains in the business (so f*** you LinkedIn).
[h4] Why SoDA?
[p] It’s where the world’s most forward‑thinking agencies world’s most forward‑thinking agencies swap ideas, make great work, and keep raising the bar ... and somehow, us.
[h4] What This Means
[p] We get access to conversations that go beyond the usual agency small talk. Real talk about creative leadership, operational excellence, AI, innovation, and all the juicy bits in between.
[p] It also means more opportunities to:
[p] – Collaborate with like-minded studios
[p] – Share what we’ve learned (and what we’ve messed up)
[p] – Champion better, smarter, more original creative work
[h4] Not really our thing
[p] We’ve never been the “joiner” type. But SoDA isn’t another badge, it’s a community of businesses that help each other. And we’re excited to show up, speak up, and help build something that lasts.
[p] So here’s to new faces, new perspectives, and hopefully a few new mates along the way.

[h1] Privacy Policy
[h4] General Use
[p] By using our site, you consent to our websites privacy policy.
[h4] Connect Recorder
[p] Our Connect page features a voice recorder that you can use to record a message. The recorder asks for permission to access your device microphone before capturing any audio. Once sent, the audio is stored in a private folder on https://cloudinary.com.
[p] If you wish for your audio to be deleted from https://cloudinary.com, please send us an email stating your request, including a general description of the message and the time/ date you submitted it.
[p] Once we receive recordings, we may choose to move them to our answer machine, also featured on our Connect page. Before moving the audio, we reserve the right to:
[li] Trim the audio.
[li] Censor/remove any personally identifying information about the user who submitted the audio.
[li] Adjust the audio settings for comedic effect.
[h4] Analytics
[p] We use Google Analytics to track baseline data about the usage of our site. We don't store any personal information about our users, just the pages that they view so that we can keep an eye on what content is popular. We don't give users the option to turn analytics off because all data is anonymous anyway. If you desperately don't want your anonymous site usage to be tracked then please don't use the site.
[h4] Cookies
[p] We don't set any cookies ourselves, but cookies do get set by third parties. These are:
[li] _ga: Google Analytics
[li] _ga_5NVMKC92BC: Google Analytics
[h4] Third-Party Links
[p] We take no responsibility for the content or individual policies of third-party websites we link to from our site.

[h1] Ink Games
[h2] A New Era of Gaming
[p] INK Games is a next-gen gaming platform that blends real-world rewards with immersive digital experiences.
[p] Our challenge was to craft a site that matched the ambition of their platform—interactive, fluid, and future-facing—without compromising performance.
[p] We designed and developed a high-impact, animation-rich experience using a shared 3D canvas system powered by React Three Fiber and GSAP. Custom “portal cards” blend DOM and WebGL layers, creating dynamic, perspective-driven content blocks that respond to scroll and cursor movement. The end result is a seamless digital experience that feels as alive as the games themselves.

[h1] Twitch
[h2] Entertainment Your Way
[p] Twitch embarked on an exciting rebrand and sought to amplify it across their website’s marketing pages. Partnering with Instrument, we swiftly iterated concepts to weave the new visual identity into site designs, using type, colour, copy, and motion to bring the branding to life in the most captivating way.
